scope: Public static image acquisition and Markdown presentation only; no PoC, scanner or example target executed/accessed. No redaction. Raster decoding and static SVG review do not mean visual review of every image.
limitations: 260 unavailable image positions retain the complete original reference as literal text; no remote loading.
29 unavailable full-image click targets explicitly point to the already archived local preview, not an unproven original.
Remote source/article links remain references. Existing blog JavaScript/CSS CDN dependencies are outside image localization scope.
15 pre-existing render candidates and historical quality warnings remain; this is not a claim that all technical material is correct or reproduced.
No-suffix full-image links different from their preview require source/MIME review; the offline gate cannot infer content type from an arbitrary URL.
